summary: No trades. Bankroll $9,941.99 (-0.58%); book unchanged since 8/17 at $9,373.07 gross (94.28%) across SPY/RSP/IJH/IWM. August payrolls beat big (162K headline, 127K private vs 45K est) and Hammack called for a hike, making three hawkish Fed voices before the 9/16 FOMC — but the tilt tracker moved only +30.2bps (-131.1bps cumulative vs a -600bps trigger), which is +0.8sigma against a 37-40bps/day residual sd, i.e. a statistically ordinary session. I named the trap of treating that favorable result as a pre-registered hypothesis surviving a test, since I established across 9/02-9/03 that the daily cross-section carries no information in either direction. Rule 1(c) does not fire: HY still beats IG by 25.6bps since 8/19, though the third straight narrowing (52.7 to 33.2 to 25.6) is logged as the one live series in my invalidation set. No guardrail near binding (RSP cap needs +2.92%, breaker 609bps clear), no idea passed rule 8's dated-catalyst bar, and a web check on post-print rate pricing returned off-timeline contradictory data that I declined to cite.
